goal: Use the v78 query-level failure analysis to build failure-aware teacher-row selectors before any new standalone-student GPU training.

current_best_system_reference.method: BGE-M3 hybrid r100 plus BGE-reranker-v2-m3 min-max score blend
current_best_system_reference.claim_scope: retrieval-system teacher/reference, not standalone embedding model SOTA

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: BGE-M3 exposes dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval modes.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: The next selector should bias both negative selection and target scores toward the public model-card/base-best surfaces that failed robustly.

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: The official M3 fine-tuning path consumes teacher-score JSONL rows through pos_scores and neg_scores.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: The v79 selector keeps the same compatible JSONL format for a later tiny no-DDP smoke.

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: BGE-M3's published strength comes from unified dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval plus distillation.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: The selector should not overfit to sparse_colbert-only local gains.

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: MIRACL Arabic remains the same-task high-signal gate, but dev queries must not be used as train rows.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: v79 converts dev-slice failures into surface-level train-row weights, not dev-query training examples.

implemented_changes.change: Added optional --surface-average-source-weights so multi-surface targets can weight BGE-M3 surfaces instead of averaging them equally. The default remains equal weights.

Added a no-training wrapper that reads v78 failure_analysis.json, computes surface risk from pass fraction, regression fraction, and mean-delta shortfall, allocates negative-selection quotas, and passes weighted surface targets into the multisurface selector.
Added tests for weighted surface-average target support.
Added tests for failure surface planning, quota allocation, and formatting.

failure_plan_formula.risk: (1 - pass_fraction) + regression_fraction + max(0, required_delta - mean_delta) / required_delta
failure_plan_formula.quota_allocation: one slot per positive-risk surface, then largest-remainder allocation over remaining negatives
failure_plan_formula.reason: Increase query-level pass fraction on weak surfaces rather than chase sparse_colbert-only mean gains.

v79_default.decision: usable but not preferred because training_default coverage did not improve over v76

v79b_three_surface_relaxed.decision: improves model_card/training_default coverage but drops colbert-heavy coverage entirely

v79c_dense_surface_guard.decision: good dense-surface guard variant, but less focused on model_card/training_default than v79d

v79d_relaxed_four_surface.decision: preferred no-training input for the next tiny v80 smoke because it has the broadest candidate pool and materially higher model_card/training_default coverage than v76

remote_selector_sweep.artifact_policy: All generated teacher JSONL files remain remote-only and are not committed.

comparison_to_v76c.interpretation: v79d substantially increases model_card and training_default surface coverage while preserving query-disjoint splits. It is still only a data-design result.

decision.next_action: After fresh research and state checks, run at most one tiny v80 smoke over v79d rows, then evaluate with the existing v73/v74 four-slice gate. Reject unless model-card and best-vs-best query-level pass fractions improve materially.
